line_items.reasoning: Full-year revenue guidance of $80B–$81B was reaffirmed this quarter; Q2 revenues were up 4% YoY across all five businesses with strong IB and Equities performance, but NII ex-Markets was down ~3% sequentially as guided (modestly down), keeping the full-year trajectory consistent with prior guidance.

Q2 expenses came in at $13.4B, down 6% sequentially and 2% YoY, tracking below Q1 levels exactly as guided and running at an annualized pace that is comfortably within the $53.5B–$53.8B full-year guidance range, with additional medium-term savings of $2B–$2.5B announced.

Retail Services NCL rate was guided to the high end of the 5.75%–6.25% range, and Q2 results confirmed it is tracking to exactly that high end, matching the updated guidance rather than surprising in either direction.

The medium-term ROTCE target of 11%–12% and expense range of $51B–$53B were reaffirmed again this quarter; Q2 ROTCE of 7.2% is below the medium-term target but consistent with the multi-year glide path, and no guidance was changed.
